mapper.select:
SELECT attendance_date as attendanceDate, sum(case when attend_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'absenteeNumber', sum(case when attend_status !=1 then 1 else 0 end) as 'clockNumber', count(*) as 'totalNumber' FROM `project_manage_attendance` where bool_delete_enum = 0 and project_id = #{projectId} and is_cancel = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(attendance_date, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{monthDate}, '%Y-%m' )
AND supplier_id = #{supplierId}
group by attendance_date

SELECT count(*) as totalMete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS currentMonthMete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS lastMonthMete FROM `project_manage_attendance` where bool_delete_enum =0 and is_cancel = 0 and attend_status != 1 and project_manage_roster_id = #{rosterId}
